svg.title: From planner goals to a weekly progress review
svg.desc: An illustrated Excalidraw board links yearly, monthly, weekly and interview plans. A sample AI review connects manually gray calendar events to two completed deliverables.
svg.text: Connect your calendar to your goals
Keep every planning horizon on one board, then ask for a weekly review.
One board. Editable text. Movable cards. Connected plans.
Review my week against the plan.
Reserve time to record the demo.
Gray events are manual completion evidence.
Fictional sample content · AI response shown is an example, not a guarantee of an outcome
